name: Oluwaferanmi Kolade
story: My name is Oluwaferanmi Kolade, and I am a graphic designer. For years, I offered my graphic design services to my family, friends, and church free of charge. Although I loved creating and serving others, I wasn't earning from my skill or building a sustainable career. Everything changed when a friend introduced me to this team where I learnt how I could develop my skills, position myself as a successful freelancer, and maximize my potential.  I decided to give the opportunity a chance, and that decision transformed my freelancing journey. I learned how to package my skills professionally, attract clients, and turn my passion into a steady source of income. Today, I earn a stable income as a graphic designer, and I'm grateful I took that step.
